source: Make me a roleplay game like brookhaven you can get houes, tools,shhops an exact copy but just loooks different, Thank you!

image_prompt.text: Wide, flat, grid-aligned streets — 15 studs minimum one-way, 30 studs two-way — snaking between the residential streets and the shop strip
Clear physical separation between the commercial strip of shops and the quiet residential streets
Houses and shops that players go inside

notes: Shape also carries P4 if house interiors turn out to be per-player instances; the prompt does not say which.

Preset caveat from the genre file: full player-constructed housing is the least common housing model in this genre, and the game the user named is a claimable-house game, so a grid of empty lots may be the wrong model.
No option covers obtainable handheld tools, so that request is unbuilt.
The user asked for an exact copy of a named game that looks different — a constraint over the whole build with no field to hold it.

open_questions.ask: You want it to look different from Brookhaven — should it read as modern suburban with different props, or a completely different setting such as fantasy or retro?
Do players build their own house on an empty lot, or claim and decorate a house that is already standing?

coverage_missing.ask: You want it to look different from Brookhaven — should it read as modern suburban with different props, or a completely different setting?
Do players build their own house on a lot, or claim a pre-built one?

answers.ask: You want it to look different from Brookhaven — should it read as modern suburban with different props, or a completely different setting such as fantasy or retro?
answers.answer: Keep it modern suburban, but use different-looking props, buildings, and layout so it has its own look.

answers.ask: Do players build their own house on an empty lot, or claim and decorate a house that is already standing?
answers.answer: Players should claim an already-standing house and decorate it; no house-building system is needed.
